meta.how: subagent reads SKILL.md, uses scripts/search.py and data/

answers.howto-save-classes: (a) step wrapper: <div class="rank-math-howto-step">; (b) step title: <h3 class="rank-math-howto-title"> (tag = titleWrapper, default h3; omitted if title empty); (c) step content: <div class="rank-math-howto-content"> (omitted if content empty). (The PHP front-end render uses different classes: rank-math-step / rank-math-step-title / rank-math-step-content.)
answers.site-howto-sizeslug: sizeSlug "large" (the plugin default is "full" and save() ignores it); this site style is taken from moksaweb.com post 8594, the canonical form. It is 站內風格, not a Rank Math requirement.
answers.density-075-gap: Exactly 0.75% gets the full 6/6 points ('best'). It falls in a gap caused by lodash inRange's exclusive upper bound: fair is 0.5 up to but not including 0.75, good starts at 0.76, so 0.75 matches neither and drops through to the best (up to 2.5) branch.
answers.powerword-prefix: At most 4 characters longer: the title word must equal a power word or start with one and be no more than 4 characters longer (analyzer.js titleHasPowerWords, 1.0.282).
answers.powerword-locale-count: 11 language files (de, en, es, fi, fr, hu, id, it, ja, nl, sv). Chinese is not among them, so the power-word test is skipped on zh sites.
answers.video-self-hosted: No. A video counts only if its iframe/video/[video] URL or a bare URL is YouTube or Vimeo, so a self-hosted .mp4 does not count.
answers.sample-density: FK density 1.96% (14 occurrences) and 714 wp.wordcount words; it passes 8 passed, 0 failed (content length 2/8, density 6/6 in the 1.0-2.5% band).
answers.post-title-english-trust: Trust is 推論 (inferred). It is a moksaweb.com habit, and the reason behind it (CJK font / breakage) was never measured; it is listed as an open question in pending.csv.
answers.wordcount-port-version: @wordpress/wordcount version 5.1.0, compared on 3 files (the port matched on all of them).
answers.gallery-alt: The test still passes (2 points): a [gallery] shortcode in the content satisfies keywordInImageAlt even when no contains the keyword.
answers.platforms-trust: All 8 are 推論 (inferred). The templates say verified:true (since v1.1.0 commit 8c97a29), but they record no doc URL or date, so the paths cannot be traced to a source; re-checking them is an open pending.csv item.
answers.howto-attr-count: 16 attributes (hasDuration, days, hours, minutes, description, steps, sizeSlug, imageID, mainSizeSlug, listStyle, timeLabel, titleWrapper, listCssClasses, titleCssClasses, contentCssClasses, textAlign). The default titleWrapper is h3.
